title: Response to the Letter to the Editor, “Comment on 'Readability and performance of AI chatbot responses to frequently asked questions in maxillofacial prosthodontics'”
html: We sincerely thank the authors for their thoughtful comments regarding our article, “Readability and Performance of AI Chatbot Responses to Frequently Asked Questions in Maxillofacial Prosthodontics.”1 We appreciate their interest in our work and their recognition of the importance of evaluating artificial intelligence (AI)-generated patient education materials within the field of maxillofacial prosthodontics. As AI tools become increasingly accessible to patients seeking health information, ongoing discussion regarding appropriate methodologies and interpretation of findings is both timely and valuable.
